title: Unit Event — On This Blank Canvas, I Paint — Episode7 I Don't Want to Run

meta.Event: On This Blank Canvas, I Paint
meta.Episode: Episode7 — I Don't Want to Run
meta.Event Outline: As N25's music evolves, Ena struggles to capture the true essence of their songs in her art. In the interest of keeping up with the group, she considers going back to her old art class...

rows.Line: Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Well, I'm here...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (There's definitely a chance that she's gonna call me a worrywart or something for surprising her like this...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
No...
This isn't it at all...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
More colors...
No, this part needs to be darker...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ugh... It looks like a mess...
Now I have to redraw it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Ena... She's in so much pain...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (What do I do...?)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Isn't there anything I can do for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Rin...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness...
She seems a little better now.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Are you okay, Ena...?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No... I don't think so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nothing's working. I keep drawing and drawing, but it looks all wrong...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to get better to keep up with the rest of N25. I have to catch up to them...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But it hurts so much...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know that I have to keep drawing, but every time I do, I become so overwhelmed with pain that my mind goes blank...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? A message...?
From who...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <Enanan, would it be possible for us to talk?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<They're all worried about you.
They want to help...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay...
Thanks, Rin.
bgm_area00005
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry for making you wait, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade? Mafuyu? You're here too?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, after much discussion.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We didn't realize Rin was with you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Also after much discussion...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
More importantly, I'm so sorry.
I keep getting stuck after promising to get this thing done...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's okay.
We know that you're trying your best, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Also... Sorry, but we had Mizuki tell us more about the art class you've been attending.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I feel awful for not realizing that you think you need to get better to catch up to us...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
It's not your fault, Kanade.
It's my fault for not being a better illustrator...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's like all that time I was gone has come back to haunt me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Everyone else seems to know exactly how to draw what they want to draw...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: While I'm so far behind that I'm struggling to do even the most basic things...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My mind's telling me to just keep drawing and doing whatever I can to get better.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But my body can't handle it...
Every time I go, I start shaking because I'm so scared of going to that class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I can't do what the others can do and I know I'm never going to receive positive criticism. More than anything, I can't forgive myself for letting this all happen...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I keep asking myself, “Why did I run away that time...?”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But I want to keep drawing...
I want to prevent being left behind by N25 at all costs...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At least, that's what my mind's telling me.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think you were running away from anything, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It may be true that drawing illustrations for N25 won't necessarily give you opportunities to learn anything new or improve your skills.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But in my opinion, your art has improved compared to when we first met. It's clear that you're always looking for the best way to illustrate the music Mafuyu and I make.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I've recently been catching myself thinking just how much I like what you draw, Ena. You have this way of conveying so many different feelings all at once.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But feelings aren't enough.
Those alone won't get me anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: At this rate, if I stop growing as an artist...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't know if you've grown as an artist...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I remember being confused by your old illustrations in terms of what you were trying to express because of how you used odd colors and bent lines.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? FYI, that was all on purpose...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(But in retrospect...
I guess I could've done better to get my message across.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But now, things seem a little different.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still confused sometimes, but I understand your art better than before.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ena...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know this is a lot to process...
But I don't want you to think that these past two years were a complete waste.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your illustrations have helped us so much. They've helped N25 so much.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (During these past two years, I...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I found N25 and decided to give art another try.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After that... We met for the first time in SEKAI, I did terribly in that contest and became almost incurably depressed...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I realized that I want to keep drawing for N25...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ena, you gotta see this.
All of N25's videos!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, look. We're up to this many now because Kanade keeps churning out new songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry. I can't help myself since I'm still determined to compose a song that can save people...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
Why are you apologizing?
I need you to keep composing for the foreseeable future.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa, talk about a blast from the past...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I really like what you drew for some of our old stuff! It's kinda rough, but it gives it that sort of edge, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, this one too!
Remember how you had some trouble coming up with ideas and we ended up making it together?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, I redrew it so many times because I didn't know which motifs to go with and it took forever to finish.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I like this one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? This one...? We uploaded it just the other day, didn't we?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah. As much as I like your old illustrations, I like your recent ones more. Your weird choice of colors is like an expression of who you are, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Is that supposed to be a compliment?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I don't know much about art...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But if you really felt like running away, I doubt you would've drawn all these things.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Is she right?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know... No, I ran away for two years... That's just the cold, hard truth...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I really drew all these...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Together... With N25...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks, all of you...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I feel like trying a little bit more now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Okay.
Good luck, Ena.
